title: Poincare disk model with verified neutral geometry axioms

problemStatement.formal: In the Beltrami-Klein disk model, there exist a point P and a chord l with two distinct chords through P parallel to l; hence BKPlayfair fails and the parallel postulate is independent from the neutral incidence axioms modeled here.
problemStatement.plain: Constructs the Beltrami-Klein disk model of hyperbolic geometry with explicit coordinate geometry and proves the hyperbolic parallel property concretely, establishing independence of the parallel postulate via model construction.
whyMatters: The independence of the parallel postulate is clearest when a concrete hyperbolic model is on the page.
The Beltrami-Klein coordinates make the failure of Playfair uniqueness visible as explicit chords through one point.
The metadata should distinguish the checked coordinate witnesses from the one incidence reconstruction axiom.

proven: `DiskPoint`, `Chord`, `OnChord`, `ChordParallel`, `xaxis`, and `P` define the Beltrami-Klein coordinate setup.
The coordinate witness lemmas verify that P is not on xaxis, lies on two distinct witness chords, and both witness chords are parallel to xaxis.
`eucGeom` and `euc_satisfies_playfair` supply the contrasting Euclidean incidence model.
open: `two_points_determine_chord` is the sole axiom in `ParallelPostulateIndependenceOQ02.lean`; the file has zero sorries.
knownResults.goal: Backfill the concrete model-theoretic witness for failure of Playfair uniqueness and state the remaining incidence axiom explicitly.
